segments.name: Maintenance Services
segments.description: Delivers recurring commercial landscaping, snow removal and tree care services to commercial customers throughout the United States.
segments.evidence: Our Maintenance Services segment delivers a full suite of recurring commercial landscaping services in both evergreen and seasonal markets, ranging from mowing, gardening, mulching and snow removal, to more horticulturally advanced services, such as water management, irrigation maintenance, tree care and golf course maintenance.

segments.name: Development Services
segments.description: Provides landscape architecture, design and installation for new facilities and significant redesign projects, typically hired through general contractors.
segments.evidence: Through our Development Services segment, we provide landscape architecture and development services for new facilities and significant redesign projects.

revenueModel.text: Commercial customers pay under recurring maintenance and snow removal contracts, and under project fees for landscape development work.
revenueModel.evidence: Fees for contracted landscape maintenance services are typically billed on an equal monthly basis.

changes.text: The company divested its U.S. Lawns business in 2024.
changes.evidence: Represents the realized gain on sale and transaction related expenses from the divestiture of U.S. Lawns on January 12, 2024.
